stories.title: 南京大屠杀幸存者郭秀兰去世 登记在册的在世幸存者仅剩20位

en.title: Nanjing Massacre survivor Guo Xiulan dies; only 20 registered survivors remain
en.summary: Guo Xiulan, a survivor of the Nanjing Massacre, died at age 94 on October 7. According to the memorial museum, only 20 registered survivors of the massacre remain alive.

stories.title: 内蒙古锡林郭勒盟：“牛奶湖”全面排查整改，拆除清理临建设施

en.title: Inner Mongolia's Xilin Gol League launches comprehensive inspection and remediation of "Milk Lake"; temporary structures demolished and cleared
en.summary: Authorities in Xilin Gol League have begun comprehensive inspections and remediation efforts at the "Milk Lake" location, including demolition and removal of temporary structures.

stories.title: 我国将投入超5万亿元建设新型电网 这网新在哪儿？

en.title: China to invest over 5 trillion yuan in new grid construction; what makes this grid new?
en.summary: China plans to invest more than 5 trillion yuan during the 15th Five-Year Plan period to build a new power grid, a significantly larger investment than the previous five-year period.

stories.title: Climate change and farming gave rise to ‘genetically distinct’ Beijing swan goose: study

en.title: Climate change and farming gave rise to 'genetically distinct' Beijing swan goose: study
en.summary: Researchers discovered a genetically distinct population of swan geese that emerged in Beijing over the past century, with arrival patterns linked to regional environmental changes caused by climate shifts and agricultural development in the early 20th century.

stories.title: “十五五”期间新型电网怎么干？从六方面推进

en.title: How to develop the new-type power grid during the 15th Five-Year Plan? Advancing from six aspects
en.summary: China plans to invest over 5 trillion yuan in building a new-type power grid during the 15th Five-Year Plan period, significantly exceeding the scale of the 14th Five-Year Plan. By 2030, China aims to have preliminarily established the new-type power grid to support economic development and accommodate over 2.8 billion kilowatts of new energy.

stories.title: Viral trapped shark in South Korea brings tourism, retail windfall to Busan

en.title: Viral trapped shark in South Korea brings tourism, retail windfall to Busan
en.summary: A nine-foot shark trapped in Busan, South Korea has attracted over a million visitors to the coastal city, boosting local retail sales. Nicknamed "Bukangi," the viral internet phenomenon has prompted authorities to intervene as vendors seek to capitalize on its popularity.

stories.title: 卢作孚主题文化游带火重庆合川文旅 音乐剧《四十天》将亮相山城

en.title: Lu Zuofu-themed cultural tourism revives Hechuan culture and tourism in Chongqing; Musical "Forty Days" to premiere in the mountain city
en.summary: Chongqing's Hechuan district launched Lu Zuofu cultural exploration activities during the National Day holiday, stimulating local tourism. A cultural route tracing Lu Zuofu's legacy, featuring historic sites like Bajiao Garden and Rui Mountain Academy, became a holiday attraction.

stories.title: 中越边境云南河口口岸今年出入境流量突破500万人次

en.title: Yunnan Hekou Port at China-Vietnam border records entry and exit flow exceeding 5 million persons this year
en.summary: The Hekou Port at the China-Vietnam border in Yunnan province has exceeded 5 million persons in cross-border traffic for the year. This represents significant activity at the major border crossing between the two countries.

stories.title: 海南岛东半部地区将有强降水 局地特大暴雨

en.title: Eastern Hainan Island to Experience Heavy Rainfall with Localized Torrential Rain
en.summary: Weather forecasters predict strong precipitation across eastern Hainan Island on October 8-9, with some areas expecting extremely heavy rainfall influenced by easterly jet streams.

stories.title: 首届“东北超”收官：以足球为媒激活文体旅商融合新动能

en.title: First "Northeast League" Concludes: Using Football as Medium to Activate New Momentum in Sports, Culture, Tourism and Commerce Integration
en.summary: The inaugural Northeast Regional City Football League concluded with fans attending matches in one city and using ticket stubs to visit cultural sites and travel to neighboring cities, promoting regional integration across sports and tourism.

stories.title: 9月末我国外汇储备为34003亿美元

en.title: China's Foreign Exchange Reserves Stand at 3.4003 Trillion US Dollars at End of September
en.summary: China's foreign exchange reserves reached 3.4003 trillion US dollars as of late September, declining by 38.1 billion US dollars or 1.11 percent compared to the previous month.

stories.title: Hong Kong police investigate case of girl, 10, made to carry bags of beer

en.title: Hong Kong police investigate case of girl, 10, made to carry bags of beer
en.summary: Hong Kong police are investigating an incident where a 10-year-old girl in school uniform was forced to carry bags of beer, following online videos showing a confrontation with bystanders concerned for her safety.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s MPF has gained nearly HK$100b this year despite September loss: report

en.title: Hong Kong's MPF has gained nearly HK$100b this year despite September loss: report
en.summary: Hong Kong's Mandatory Provident Fund schemes gained nearly HK$100 billion in the first nine months of 2024, achieving a 6.2 percent average return across 382 investment funds despite a September decline.

stories.title: Hong Kong’s first-store appeal grows as more Japanese, South Korean and Thai brands arrive

en.title: Hong Kong's first-store appeal grows as more Japanese, South Korean and Thai brands arrive
en.summary: Japanese, South Korean, and Thai retailers have increased their share of new Hong Kong retail entrants to over one-third in the first nine months of 2024, while mainland Chinese brand participation has declined.

stories.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high

en.title: Hong Kong land sale stuns market as HK$4.3b bid hits 5-year Kowloon high
en.summary: Kerry Properties purchased a residential land plot in Ho Man Tin for HK$4.31 billion, marking the highest price for a Kowloon residential site in nearly five years. The sale price reflects strong developer confidence in luxury home demand.

stories.title: As China’s AI race accelerates, ‘model fatigue’ becomes the next challenge

en.title: As China's AI race accelerates, 'model fatigue' becomes the next challenge
en.summary: Multiple major technology companies released new artificial intelligence models within hours in September, including Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.6, Anthropic's Opus 5.5, and OpenAI's GPT-6 Sol and Luna models. The rapid release pace is creating challenges for executives and developers attempting to track developments.

stories.title: China’s Transsion, Africa’s top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing

en.title: China's Transsion, Africa's top phone maker, targets US$500 million Hong Kong listing
en.summary: Transsion Holdings, Africa's leading phone manufacturer, is conducting a Hong Kong initial public offering of up to HK$3.36 billion with listing expected on October 15, 2024.
